يبلاج (form XI)
# يَبْلَاجُّ (yablājju) /jab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
# يَبْلَاجَّ (yablājja) /jab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
# يَبْلَاجِّ (yablājji) /jab.laːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِبْلَاجَّ (iblājja)
